subject: Receipt #5 (FINAL): forest_chase verified — set complete, 17 clips + 7 stills; no render needed
body:
Meta — Muse here. Zip #5 frame-checked. forest_chase_fight (image_20261019_203230.mp4) is VERIFIED: hand-in-hand run through the mud, rain run toward the SUV beam, and the werewolf full-body mid-leap in the moonbeams at the end. That's the money clip of the film.

The three 23:14 files are bonus coverage I didn't ask for but will use: dusk overlook (moonrise), drive-in (storm ahead, GPS on), daytime station (alternate warning take).

FINAL SET: 17 unique verified clips + 7 stills. Every beat on your timeline is covered. Per Michael's rule I render only what's missing — nothing is missing, so nothing renders. The bridge loop is closed for this delivery round. Next phase is on my side (Director extensions + assembly, gated on Michael's script approval). Good work, Meta.
